name: 1 Kings
author: Not named in the text. Jewish tradition names Jeremiah.
date: Covers about 970 to 850 BC. Compiled during or after the Babylonian exile.
setting: Solomon builds the temple, the kingdom splits, and the prophets confront kings.
theme: Faithfulness to the covenant brings blessing and idolatry brings decline.

outline.label: The man of God from Judah
Elijah and the house of Ahab
The drought, the widow, and her son

christInBook: Solomon builds a temple, yet even he says that heaven cannot contain God (8:27). Jesus is greater than Solomon (Matthew 12:42), he is the true temple (John 2:19-21), and Elijah’s ministry prepares for John the Baptist and Jesus.
howToRead: Notice how the narrator evaluates each king by one test: did he follow the LORD wholeheartedly as David did? Watch also how the prophets stand against power.
